label: Capture
reads: original-ticket-artifact.md, job-story/SKILL.md, ticket-changelog rule, browser-loop-setup.md when the ticket lives in ClickUp

label: write the ledger
done: orchestration.md exists with a row per phase and a Resume footer

label: write the original ticket
done: original-ticket.md Original Request is the request text unaltered, and the capture source is named - ClickUp page or user-provided text

label: write the changelog
done: the changelog exists with Requirements verbatim, and Current state, Plans and Attempt history have been read

label: write the job stories and index
done: at least one story at status draft with an index row, and no criterion names a design element

label: notify and hand off to Phase 1
done: the handoff block was emitted verbatim, and no implementation-repo file has been touched

label: Recon and plan
reads: investigation/SKILL.md, investigation-software-gaps.md, investigation-coverage-ledger.md - Problem Check is embedded in method Step 1 and never loaded separately, and investigation-question-coverage.md is never loaded

label: search prior tickets' coverage ledgers
done: the search ran before any investigative branch was opened and its result is in the plan

label: trace the problem in the code
done: every code-discoverable question was resolved by evidence rather than parked as a decision

label: run the investigation method
done: steps 1 through 7 ran - everything but the emit - the Problem Check pass is present with a finding or an explicit nothing-here per flag, and every open variable has an owner

label: stage the story reconcile
done: questions answered, criteria invalidated, and any story that must split are staged - or story movement is explicitly recorded as none

label: stage the coverage rows
done: a consult line and one coverage row per area traversed are staged, each keyed to a commit

label: stage the why-log entry
done: the class of problem and a Phase 1 why-log entry are staged

label: stage the recon-and-plan
done: the plan carries this recon's findings and not todos alone, plus the consult results and a reconcile todo for every point of the software lens, so Phase 2 is executable from it with no other context

label: Investigation report
reads: the approved plan, investigation-report.md, investigation-diagrams.md, test-plan-artifact.md, pull-request-workflow.md for the PR shell, future-development-concerns.md when the plan's todos carry a concern

label: write the recon-and-plan
done: recon-and-plan.md is present in the ticket folder

label: write the why doc
done: why-these-changes.md has a problem-class statement and a Phase 1 why-log entry

label: write the story reconcile
done: every story touched carries a Phase 1 Story log entry, the index reflects any split, and every story Open Question appears in report §10 or was closed with the evidence that closed it

label: write the investigation report
done: investigation.md exists, §5 links the diagrams with no fenced block, verdict first, §2 Problem Check is quote-grounded or explicitly nothing-here per flag, §1-§2 framing claims cite ticket text and not only code, and §8 and §10 route facts separately from decisions

label: write the coverage ledger
done: coverage-ledger.md has a Consulted line first and a Not-yet-inspected section

label: write the diagrams
done: every diagram kind is either present or carries an N/A line

label: record any concern
done: a concern named in the plan has a dated entry, otherwise the file is absent

label: seed the test plan
done: test-plan.md status reads seeded and every scenario names a criterion or the no-criterion flag

label: write the PR shell
done: pr-draft.md has all six headings, every body placeholder empty, and an unfilled note on top

label: write the changelog session log
done: the changelog has a session log entry naming what Phase 2 emitted, dated in UTC

label: notify and advance to Phase 3
done: the deferred Phase 1 notification was sent and Phase 3 began in the same mode

label: Probe and spec
reads: grill-me/SKILL.md, qa-to-spec-traceability.md, spec-writing rule, write-spec/SKILL.md and wiki-spec-authoring.md when a PRDV spec routes to the wiki

label: trace any question the code can answer
done: no code-discoverable fact was carried to you as a decision

label: run grill-me
done: each question passed its gate and was asked singly with rejected paths recorded

label: write the locked decisions
done: locked-decisions.md exists with a row per answer tracing to a source, no decision left open, and supersessions recorded rather than silently overwritten

label: record any risk-accepted decision
done: a risk-accepted decision has a concern entry that its locked-decision row cites

label: accept the job stories
done: every story index row reads accepted, or names the owner of a still-open question

label: write the spec
done: spec.md exists, links locked-decisions.md rather than repeating it, and cites the stories' acceptance criteria rather than restating or amending them

label: submit the spec to its reviewer
done: the spec - or an addendum when the reviewer already authored the spec - was actually delivered to them, pushed and PR'd where a shared wiki is the review surface rather than only written locally; or recorded not-applicable naming who owns the spec and why no review is owed

label: refine the test plan
done: test-plan.md status reads refined and each assertion maps to a criterion

label: write the changelog session log
done: the changelog has a session log entry naming the decisions locked and the spec written, dated in UTC

label: notify and hand off to Phase 4
done: the handoff block was emitted verbatim

label: Prep for implementation
reads: the spec, the report's handoff table and the test plan are already in the folder; new-branch-get-started.md and the build-implementation-guardrails rule

label: stage the implementation plan
done: the plan carries ordered steps, each traced to the spec, the report or the test plan AND to an acceptance criterion

label: Implement
reads: the approved plan, the test plan, the touched repo's own rules, testing-implementation-artifact.md, pull-request-workflow.md, git-commit-workflow rule, pr-review-patterns.md

label: write the implementation plan
done: implementation-plan.md is present in the ticket folder

label: confirm the reviewer approved the spec
done: the reviewer's response is recorded in the ledger with its form and date - a merged PR, a comment, or an explicit go-ahead - or a waiver naming who authorised proceeding without it and what risk that carries; no product code is written while this is unanswered

label: write the code
done: the change is implemented per the approved plan, and the refined test plan was already in place before any code was written

label: run the self-review checklist
done: every checklist item was checked against the diff before the tests ran

label: run the test plan scenarios
done: every scenario ran and produced an actually observed result - a run, a manual check or a passing suite - never a claim of what should happen

label: write the test results
done: test-plan.md status reads complete, or blocked items carry reason, risk and follow-up

label: move superseded stories to dnu/
done: no superseded story file remains outside dnu/

label: write the testing-implementation doc
done: testing-implementation.md names each scenario in dev-legible terms, flags newly-uncovered ones, and hangs every change off the scenario that forced it

label: write the changelog session log
done: the changelog has a session log entry for this work

label: run audit, then lint, then tests
done: all three ran in that order and passed before the commit, with results reported as a table giving command, scope and outcome

label: write the PR body and open the PR
done: pr-draft.md carries the description, test evidence and commit hash, and the PR is open

label: notify and hand off to Phase 6
done: the handoff block was emitted verbatim

label: write the why doc review
done: why-these-changes.md has a categorized change breakdown, Scope, Net and Verified

label: close the job stories
done: every story index row reads accepted or superseded

label: close the ledger
done: orchestration.md Phase 6 reads done, Resume reads complete, and the cruft check is recorded

label: write the changelog session log
done: the changelog has a closing session log entry, and Current state reflects what shipped

label: give the review summary and hand back
done: each acceptance criterion was walked against what shipped citing the results log
